title: Preston P Probable NDE 22663
content: First doctors visit for upper respiratory infection I was given an injection of penicillin and told to come back in three days for booster of same. Second visit I had no visible signs of any reaction to the drug and the nurse injected me in the buttocks with a much larger dose than the first and I immediately turned to say, ‘I can taste that in my mouth.’ She knew me well and told me to quit fooling around and pull my pants up. About the time I got my pants up, I heard a noise, sounded as if coming from the hall a oscillating up and down and increasing in strength, I turned and asked if she could hear that? Her reply was, ‘what are you talking about? Then a push to my chest, I felt like someone hit me and the nurse knew I was in trouble and helped me to the exam table and I laid on my back, feet were crossed and I remember asking her to uncross my feet. Quickly I imagined I had been given a shot of Polio by accident and I was paralyzed and so afraid. I couldn't grasp what was happening to me and she left to find the doctor. I felt a wave of numbness starting at my toes and finger tips and like neutrally warming water worked straight to my center and I became very accepting of it all and started thinking I no longer will have to eat, sleep, exercise, great peace of mind. Then I felt as if me (spirit me) was outside my body and feeling the walls of the room as skin, no more sensation of my body skin and form. I was very OK with where I was. Next the doctor and nurse return, they filled two separate syringes, pulled my pants down. He injected first a load of adrenalin that instantly raised me off the table. She immediately hit the other hip with an arresting agent and I was back. That's what happened and I look so forward to the day I have my next Birthday

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt 'spirit me' outside the body; described feeling the walls of the room 'as skin' and having 'no more sensation of my body skin and form.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Injection of penicillin at a doctor's visit for an upper respiratory infection; reaction treated with adrenalin and an 'arresting agent.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Auditory phenomenon ('noise... oscillating up and down and increasing in strength'), numbness spreading from extremities, and a sudden physical jolt ('push to my chest').
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel/light/realm; experience centered on bodily reaction, peace/acceptance, then OBE-like separation, then rapid medical intervention and return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported tasting the injection in his mouth; heard a hall-like oscillating noise increasing in strength; described feeling the walls of the room 'as skin.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I can taste that in my mouth.” / “I felt as if me (spirit me) was outside my body and feeling the walls of the room as skin, no more sensation of my body skin and form.” / “I became very accepting of it all… great peace of mind.”
